notes: BRASA is a single-file live-fire osteria site for a fictional Fishtown, Philadelphia restaurant. Includes a 32-item illustrated SVG menu with instant search/category/dietary filters, localStorage-backed basket with quantities and totals, reservation flow with date/party-aware unavailable slots and confirmation, real-time open/closed hours with special-hours handling, mobile nav, scroll reveals, and an interactive ember canvas. Known limitation: no real backend for reservations/orders; map and confirmations are simulated client-side.
